requirements.title: EOSHIFT ARRAY, SHIFT, BOUNDARY, and DIM argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be an array of any type; SHIFT shall be integer and scalar for rank-one ARRAY or scalar/rank n-1 with the required shape otherwise; BOUNDARY, when present, shall have ARRAY type and type parameters and scalar or the required rank n-1 shape; DIM shall be an integer scalar in range 1 through rank(ARRAY).

pending.EOSHIFT-ARRAY-array-any-type: Positive plan uses integer, character, and derived-type arrays where BOUNDARY is present; source-control mutation supplies a scalar ARRAY and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.EOSHIFT-SHIFT-integer-scalar-or-conformi: Positive plan uses scalar SHIFT for rank one and a rank-one SHIFT matching the non-DIM shape for rank two; source-control mutation uses the wrong shift shape and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.EOSHIFT-BOUNDARY-same-type-params-scalar: Positive plan uses scalar and rank-one BOUNDARY values of the same type/length as ARRAY; source-control mutation changes CHARACTER length or shape and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.EOSHIFT-DIM-integer-scalar-valid-range: Positive plan uses DIM=1 and DIM=2 for a rank-two array; source-control mutation uses DIM=0 or rank+1 and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: EOSHIFT absent BOUNDARY uses the Table 16.4 default converted to ARRAY kind or length
requirements.definition: When BOUNDARY is absent for a Table 16.4 type, it is as if present with the listed scalar value, converted if necessary to ARRAY kind type parameter or character length.

pending.EOSHIFT-default-boundary-integer-zero: Use integer ARRAY [4,5,6] with SHIFT=1 and absent BOUNDARY expecting [5,6,0], plus explicit BOUNDARY=99 companion expecting [5,6,99] so the zero default is not vacuous.
pending.EOSHIFT-default-boundary-real-zero: Use exactly representable nonzero real ARRAY with SHIFT=1 and compare absent BOUNDARY to explicit 0.0 of the ARRAY kind and to a nonzero-boundary companion.
pending.EOSHIFT-default-boundary-complex-zero: Use nonzero complex ARRAY with SHIFT=1 and compare absent BOUNDARY to explicit (0.0,0.0), paired with an explicit nonzero complex boundary companion.
pending.EOSHIFT-default-boundary-logical-false: Use logical ARRAY containing .TRUE. values and SHIFT=1 expecting a .FALSE. boundary, paired with BOUNDARY=.TRUE. companion so .FALSE. is not vacuous.
pending.EOSHIFT-default-boundary-character-blank: Use CHARACTER(len=3) ARRAY with nonblank values and SHIFT=1 expecting len-3 blanks at the boundary after checking LEN, paired with BOUNDARY="xyz" companion.

requirements.title: EOSHIFT maps elements by SHIFT and supplies BOUNDARY outside bounds
requirements.definition: Element (s1,...,sn) of EOSHIFT has ARRAY at index s_DIM+SHIFT (or the corresponding SHIFT element) when that subscript is within bounds, and otherwise has the scalar or indexed BOUNDARY value.

pending.EOSHIFT-positive-shift-element-mapping: Use rank-one integer [1,2,3,4] with SHIFT=2 and BOUNDARY=99 expecting [3,4,99,99]; mutate sign of SHIFT to fail.
pending.EOSHIFT-negative-shift-element-mapping: Use the same array with SHIFT=-1 and BOUNDARY=99 expecting [99,1,2,3]; positive and negative companions distinguish direction.
pending.EOSHIFT-array-valued-shift-indexing: Use a rank-two character array with DIM=2 and SHIFT vector [-1,1,0] so each row has a distinct expected mapping; mutate SHIFT to scalar to fail.
pending.EOSHIFT-boundary-used-outside-bounds: Use BOUNDARY values distinct from all ARRAY elements and check only positions whose shifted subscript is outside LBOUND/UBOUND, with retained in-bounds positions checked too.
